description: 기후에너지환경부 한강홍수통제소_수도시설 관련정보 [flood] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 기후에너지환경부 한강홍수통제소. 유역조사사업에서는 다음과 같은 수도시설 관련 정보를 수집하고 분석합니다: 댐 및 저수지의 수위 및 유량: 댐과 저수지의 수위와 유량을 모니터링하여 수자원의 변동을 파악합니다. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 기후에너지환경부 한강홍수통제소. Its tags are 시설물, 생활용수, 수도, 시설유지관리, 유역조사. It offers 1 resource(s) in xml. The portal shows 2025-06-12 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
